## Ad creative measurement

### Account audit

- **Lead:** [`agency:paid-media-auditor`](../toolkit/cards/advertising/ad-creative-measurement/agency--paid-media-auditor.md) — Paid Media Auditor Agent is 3RDWRONG’s lead for account audit in ad creative measurement.
- **Specialist:** [`agency-mcp:seo-audit`](../toolkit/cards/advertising/ad-creative-measurement/agency-mcp--seo-audit.md) — SEO audit is a 3RDWRONG specialist for account audit, activated only when its registry trigger applies.
  Trigger: Use for the named audit, measurement, compliance, or reporting task when its evidence and data source are available.
- **Specialist:** [`skill:ad-account-auditor`](../toolkit/cards/advertising/ad-creative-measurement/skill--ad-account-auditor.md) — Ad Account Auditor is a 3RDWRONG specialist for account audit, activated only when its registry trigger applies.
  Trigger: Use for advertising/ad-creative-measurement/account-audit when the brief specifically requires: Use when auditing a paid ad account for incremental contribution, wasted spend, or measurement integrity before scaling; runs a typed 20-item ROAS profile with verified vetoes and a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK/UNDECIDED gate on own exported data .

  Trigger: Use for advertising/ad-creative-measurement/ad-creative when the brief specifically requires: Use when the user asks to "QA my conversion tracking before launch", "check my UTMs / pixel / event firing", "set up a tracking pre-flight", or "set the dedup rule so Meta and Google stop double-counting"; builds and fixes the measurement plumbing — conversion-event firing, UTM hygiene, cross-platform dedup rules, attribution-window alignment, and offline/iOS-ATT modeled-gap flags — as a pre-flight checklist plus a UTM/event-spec builder .
- **Specialist:** [`skill:conversion-value-mapper`](../toolkit/cards/advertising/ad-creative-measurement/skill--conversion-value-mapper.md) — Conversion Value Mapper is a 3RDWRONG specialist for ad creative, activated only when its registry trigger applies.
  Trigger: Use for advertising/ad-creative-measurement/ad-creative when the brief specifically requires: Use when the user asks to "set up conversion values so tROAS optimizes profit not orders", "map margin onto my purchase value", "build value rules for lead / phone / signup conversions", or "stop bidding to revenue when I care about profit"; defines and QAs the conversion VALUE model — per-conversion values, margin/net-value adjustment, static-vs-dynamic value rules, proxy values for non-revenue actions, and a value-vs-count sanity check — as a value-model spec plus a pre-launch value QA sheet .
- **Specialist:** [`skill:placement-exclusion-manager`](../toolkit/cards/advertising/ad-creative-measurement/skill--placement-exclusion-manager.md) — Placement Exclusion Manager is a 3RDWRONG specialist for ad creative, activated only when its registry trigger applies.

- **Specialist:** [`skill:platform-norm-profiler`](../toolkit/cards/advertising/ad-creative-measurement/skill--platform-norm-profiler.md) — Platform Norm Profiler is a 3RDWRONG specialist for ad creative, activated only when its registry trigger applies.
